## What is Stress?

Stress is the body's response to any demand or challenge. While some stress can be motivating, chronic or overwhelming stress can negatively affect your well-being.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/YOUR_VIDEO_ID" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen>

</iframe>

::: callout-tip
**Reflect:** Think of a recent stressful experience. How did your body react? What thoughts did you have?
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Understanding Resilience

Resilience is the ability to bounce back from challenges. It involves adaptability, emotional strength, and support systems.
